تعتمرون (form VIII)
# تَعْتَمِرُونَ (taʕtamirūna) /taʕ.ta.mi.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَمَرَ (iʕtamara)
# تُعْتَمَرُونَ (tuʕtamarūna) /tuʕ.ta.ma.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَمَرَ (iʕtamara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
